search_reduction.units: candidates_generated counts what was expanded -- words on the baseline, distinct observation vectors on the represented run, which is the reduction itself and not a change of question. search_nodes counts state updates against matrix actions. rejected_candidates is in WORDS on both sides, because the represented run carries the multiplicity of each vector

state_reduction.sense: the search over raw states keeps frame and centre apart even when the question cannot tell them apart; the observation vector is what the question actually reads
